item.punizioni.executioner_hood.desc1: Black, two holes for the eyes: the executioner has no face and no name.
item.punizioni.executioner_hood.desc2: Hides the name over your head.
item.punizioni.executioner_apron.desc1: Thick leather, stained with old blood. With studded bracers.
item.punizioni.cat_o_nine_tails.desc1: Every lash leaves a red welt on the back, on the skin.
item.punizioni.cat_o_nine_tails.desc2: Hurts even more on the whipping post.
item.punizioni.executioner_axe.desc1: Hit whoever is at the block: a hand or a foot comes off.
item.punizioni.executioner_axe.desc2: Right click at the block: choose what to cut.
item.punizioni.executioner_mallet.desc1: Hit whoever is tied to the wheel: one bone at a time.
item.punizioni.executioner_mallet.desc2: The bones stay crooked until death.
item.punizioni.executioner_torch.desc1: Pitch and rags: lights the stake and the fire under the bull.
item.punizioni.executioner_torch.desc2: Flint and steel, torches, fire charges and lava work too.
item.punizioni.whipping_post.desc1: Whoever stands in front gets chained: then the cat-o'-nine-tails.
item.punizioni.iron_maiden.desc1: Whoever goes in does not come out: the doors close on the spikes.
item.punizioni.iron_maiden.desc2: Right click: close. Again, while shut: mercy.
item.punizioni.quartering_rack.desc1: Four black horses pull the arms and legs.
item.punizioni.quartering_rack.desc2: The executioner decides: stop them (stretched body) or let them tear.
item.punizioni.chopping_block.desc1: A hand on the block, then the axe.
item.punizioni.chopping_block.desc2: Hands and feet do not grow back: only death heals.
item.punizioni.rat_table.desc1: Tied to the table, the cage opens.
item.punizioni.rat_table.desc2: Right click: open the cage. Again: call the rats back.
item.punizioni.pyre.desc1: Tied to the post, on the pyre.
item.punizioni.pyre.desc2: Light it with the torch; put it out with a water bucket.
item.punizioni.guillotine.desc1: The lunette on the neck, the blade up high.
item.punizioni.guillotine.desc2: The head drops into the basket (and its owner sees it all).
item.punizioni.wheel.desc1: Tied to the spokes: the mallet breaks the bones.
item.punizioni.wheel.desc2: Then the wheel goes up the post and turns. The crows come.
item.punizioni.brazen_bull.desc1: In through the hatch, the fire underneath.
item.punizioni.brazen_bull.desc2: The screams come out of the nostrils as bellows.
item.punizioni.gallows.desc1: The noose round the neck, the trapdoor under the feet.
item.punizioni.gallows.desc2: Right click: open the trapdoor. Sword or shears: cut the rope.
